newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Israel's Mordechai to reschedule talks with Arafat.
newsitem.headline: Israel's Mordechai to reschedule talks with Arafat.

text.p: Palestinian President Yasser Arafat and Israel's Defence Minister Yitzhak Mordechai have put off their meeting planned for Sunday due to hectic schedules, Palestinian and Israeli officials said on Saturday.
But an Israeli Defence Ministry spokesman said Mordechai will telephone Arafat on Sunday to reschedule the meeting.
"He will call Arafat on Sunday morning to set a date and the meeting will happen soon, probably later this week," Defence Ministry spokesman Avi Benayahu said.
Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu announced after his landmark summit with Arafat on Wednesday that Mordechai and Arafat would meet on Sunday.
"The meeting has been postponed because both men at this point have busy schedules," said Palestinian negotiator Hassan Asfour.
Arafat is due to travel on Monday to Japan where he will brief government officials on his talks with Netanyahu and discuss bilateral relations.
